### listOrgEvents

`events.listOrgEvents`

Return Events from One Organization: returns events for the specified organization (paged with pageNum / itemsPerPage)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.events.listOrgEvents({ orgId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718' });
```

## Federated Authentication

### createIdentityProvider

Create One Identity Provider: creates one identity provider within the specified federation

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.federatedAuthentication.createIdentityProvider({
	federationSettingsId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	body: {},
});
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `federationSettingsId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your federation. |
| `body` | `object` | Yes | — |

### createRoleMapping

`federatedAuthentication.createRoleMapping`

Create One Role Mapping in One Organization Configuration: adds one role mapping to the specified organization in the specified federation

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.federatedAuthentication.createRoleMapping({
	federationSettingsId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	orgId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	externalGroupName: 'example',
	roleAssignments: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `federationSettingsId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your federation. |
| `orgId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization that contains your projects. Use the [`/orgs`](#tag/Organizations/operation/listOrganizations) endpoint to retrieve all organizations to which the authenticated user has access. |
| `externalGroupName` | `string` | Yes | Unique human-readable label that identifies the identity provider group to which this role mapping applies. |
| `roleAssignments` | `object[]` | Yes | Atlas roles and the unique identifiers of the groups and organizations associated with each role. The array must include at least one element with an Organization role and its respective `orgId`. Each element in the array can have a value for `orgId` or `groupId`, but not both. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="roleAssignments full type">

```ts
{
  groupId?: string,
  orgId?: string,
  role?: string
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `externalGroupName` | `string \| null` | No | Unique human-readable label that identifies the identity provider group to which this role mapping applies. |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies this role mapping. |
| `roleAssignments` | `object[] \| null` | No | Atlas roles and the unique identifiers of the groups and organizations associated with each role. The array must include at least one element with an Organization role and its respective `orgId`. Each element in the array can have a value for `orgId` or `groupId`, but not both. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="roleAssignments full type">

```ts
{
  groupId?: string | null,
  orgId?: string | null,
  role?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### deleteFederationSetting

`federatedAuthentication.deleteFederationSetting`

Delete One Federation Settings Instance: deletes the federation settings instance and all associated data, including identity providers and domains

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.federatedAuthentication.deleteFederationSetting({ federationSettingsId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `federationSettingsId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your federation. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | MongoDBAtlas accepted the call; it answered with no body (or an empty object). |



---

### deleteIdentityProvider

`federatedAuthentication.deleteIdentityProvider`

Delete One Identity Provider: deletes one identity provider in the specified federation

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.federatedAuthentication.deleteIdentityProvider({ federationSettingsId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', identityProviderId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `federationSettingsId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your federation. |
| `identityProviderId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the identity provider to connect. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | MongoDBAtlas accepted the call; it answered with no body (or an empty object). |

### deleteRoleMapping

`federatedAuthentication.deleteRoleMapping`

Remove One Role Mapping from One Organization: removes one role mapping in the specified organization from the specified federation

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.federatedAuthentication.deleteRoleMapping({ federationSettingsId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', id: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', orgId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `federationSettingsId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your federation. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the role mapping that you want to remove. |
| `orgId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization that contains your projects. Use the [`/orgs`](#tag/Organizations/operation/listOrganizations) endpoint to retrieve all organizations to which the authenticated user has access. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | MongoDBAtlas accepted the call; it answered with no body (or an empty object). |

### getConnectedOrgConfig

`federatedAuthentication.getConnectedOrgConfig`

Return One Organization Configuration from One Federation: returns the specified connected organization configuration from the specified federation

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.federatedAuthentication.getConnectedOrgConfig({ federationSettingsId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', orgId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `federationSettingsId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your federation. |
| `orgId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the connected organization configuration to return. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `dataAccessIdentityProviderIds` | `string[] \| null` | No | The collection of unique ids representing the identity providers that can be used for data access in this organization. |
| `domainAllowList` | `string[] \| null` | No | Approved domains that restrict users who can join the organization based on their email address. |
| `domainRestrictionEnabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Value that indicates whether domain restriction is enabled for this connected organization. |
| `identityProviderId` | `string \| null \| null` | No | Legacy 20-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the UI access identity provider that this connected organization configuration is associated with. This id can be found within the Federation Management Console &gt; Identity Providers tab by clicking the info icon in the IdP ID row of a configured identity provider. |
| `orgId` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the connected organization configuration. |
| `postAuthRoleGrants` | `(string \| null)[] \| null` | No | Atlas roles that are granted to a user in this organization after authenticating. Roles are a human-readable label that identifies the collection of privileges that MongoDB Cloud grants a specific MongoDB Cloud user. These roles can only be organization specific roles. |
| `roleMappings` | `object[] \| null` | No | Role mappings that are configured in this organization. |
| `userConflicts` | `object[] \| null` | No | List that contains the users who have an email address that doesn't match any domain on the allowed list. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="roleMappings full type">

```ts
{
  externalGroupName?: string | null,
  id?: string | null,
  roleAssignments?: {
    groupId?: string | null,
    orgId?: string | null,
    role?: string | null
  }[] | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="userConflicts full type">

```ts
{
  emailAddress?: string | null,
  federationSettingsId?: string | null,
  firstName?: string | null,
  lastName?: string | null,
  userId?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getFederationSettings

`federatedAuthentication.getFederationSettings`

Return Federation Settings for One Organization: returns information about the federation settings for the specified organization

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.federatedAuthentication.getFederationSettings({ orgId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `orgId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization that contains your projects. Use the [`/orgs`](#tag/Organizations/operation/listOrganizations) endpoint to retrieve all organizations to which the authenticated user has access. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `federatedDomains` | `string[] \| null` | No | List of domains associated with the organization's identity provider. |
| `hasRoleMappings` | `boolean \| null` | No | Flag that indicates whether this organization has role mappings configured. |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies this federation. |
| `identityProviderId` | `string \| null` | No | Legacy 20-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the identity provider connected to this organization. |
| `identityProviderStatus` | `string \| null` | No | String enum that indicates whether the identity provider is active. |

### getIdentityProvider

| `dataAccessIdentityProviderIds` | `string[]` | No | The collection of unique ids representing the identity providers that can be used for data access in this organization. |

| `roleMappings` | `object[]` | No | Role mappings that are configured in this organization. |

## Flex Restore Jobs

### createFlexRestoreJob

`flexRestoreJobs.createFlexRestoreJob`

Create One Restore Job for One Flex Cluster: restores one snapshot of one flex cluster from the specified project

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.flexRestoreJobs.createFlexRestoreJob({
	groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	name: 'Cluster0',
	snapshotId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	targetDeploymentItemName: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the flex cluster whose snapshot you want to restore. |
| `snapshotId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the snapshot to restore. |
| `targetDeploymentItemName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the instance or cluster on the target project to which you want to restore the snapshot. You can restore the snapshot to another flex cluster or dedicated cluster tier. |
| `targetProjectId` | `string` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project that contains the instance or cluster to which you want to restore the snapshot. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `deliveryType` | `string \| null` | No | Means by which this resource returns the snapshot to the requesting MongoDB Cloud user. |
| `expirationDate` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when the download link no longer works. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the restore job. |
| `instanceName` | `string \| null` | No | Human-readable label that identifies the source instance. |
| `links` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships. |
| `projectId` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project from which the restore job originated. |
| `restoreFinishedDate` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when MongoDB Cloud completed writing this snapshot. MongoDB Cloud changes the status of the restore job to `CLOSED`. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `restoreScheduledDate` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when MongoDB Cloud will restore this snapshot. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `snapshotFinishedDate` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when MongoDB Cloud completed writing this snapshot. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `snapshotId` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the snapshot to restore. |
| `snapshotUrl` | `string \| null` | No | Internet address from which you can download the compressed snapshot files. The resource returns this parameter when `"deliveryType" : "DOWNLOAD"`. |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Phase of the restore workflow for this job at the time this resource made this request. |
| `targetDeploymentItemName` | `string \| null` | No | Human-readable label that identifies the instance or cluster on the target project to which you want to restore the snapshot. You can restore the snapshot to another flex or dedicated cluster tier. |
| `targetProjectId` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project that contains the instance or cluster to which you want to restore the snapshot. |

## Global Clusters

### createCustomZoneMapping

`globalClusters.createCustomZoneMapping`

Add One Custom Zone Mapping to One Global Cluster: creates one custom zone mapping for the specified global cluster

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.globalClusters.createCustomZoneMapping({
	groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	clusterName: 'Cluster0',
	customZoneMappings: [{ location: 'example', zone: 'example' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `clusterName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies this cluster. |
| `customZoneMappings` | `object[]` | Yes | List that contains comma-separated key value pairs to map zones to geographic regions. These pairs map an ISO 3166-1a2 location code, with an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code when possible, to the human-readable label for the desired custom zone. MongoDB Cloud maps the ISO 3166-1a2 code to the nearest geographical zone by default. Include this parameter to override the default mappings. This parameter returns an empty object if no custom zones exist. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="customZoneMappings full type">

```ts
{
  location: string,
  zone: string
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `customZoneMapping` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | List that contains comma-separated key value pairs to map zones to geographic regions. These pairs map an ISO 3166-1a2 location code, with an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code when possible, to a unique 24-hexadecimal string that identifies the custom zone. The 24-hexadecimal string corresponds to a `Replication Specifications` `zoneId` property. This parameter returns an empty object if no custom zones exist. Example: `{"US-VA": "6716c5a804f4ce77e899bf99", "DE": "6716c5a804f4ce77e899bf9a"}`. |
| `managedNamespaces` | `object[] \| null` | No | List that contains a namespace for a Global Cluster. MongoDB Cloud manages this cluster. |
| `selfManagedSharding` | `boolean \| null` | No | Boolean that controls which management mode the Global Cluster is operating under. If this parameter is true Self-Managed Sharding is enabled and users are in control of the zone sharding within the Global Cluster. If this parameter is false Atlas-Managed Sharding is enabled and Atlas is control of zone sharding within the Global Cluster. |

```ts
  isCustomShardKeyHashed?: boolean | null,

}[] | null
```

### createManagedNamespace

`globalClusters.createManagedNamespace`

Create One Managed Namespace in One Global Cluster: creates one managed namespace within the specified global cluster

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.globalClusters.createManagedNamespace({
	groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	clusterName: 'Cluster0',
	collection: 'example',
	customShardKey: 'example',
	db: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `clusterName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies this cluster. |
| `collection` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label of the collection to manage for this Global Cluster. |
| `customShardKey` | `string` | Yes | Database parameter used to divide the *collection* into shards. Global clusters require a compound shard key. This compound shard key combines the location parameter and the user-selected custom key. |
| `db` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label of the database to manage for this Global Cluster. |
| `isCustomShardKeyHashed` | `boolean` | No | Flag that indicates whether someone hashed the custom shard key for the specified collection. If you set this value to `false`, MongoDB Cloud uses ranged sharding. |
| `isShardKeyUnique` | `boolean` | No | Flag that indicates whether someone [hashed](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/sh.shardCollection/#hashed-shard-keys) the custom shard key. If this parameter returns `false`, this cluster uses [ranged sharding](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/ranged-sharding/). |
| `numInitialChunks` | `number` | No | Minimum number of chunks to create initially when sharding an empty collection with a [hashed shard key](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/hashed-sharding/). |
| `presplitHashedZones` | `boolean` | No | Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Cloud should create and distribute initial chunks for an empty or non-existing collection. MongoDB Cloud distributes data based on the defined zones and zone ranges for the collection. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `customZoneMapping` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | List that contains comma-separated key value pairs to map zones to geographic regions. These pairs map an ISO 3166-1a2 location code, with an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code when possible, to a unique 24-hexadecimal string that identifies the custom zone. The 24-hexadecimal string corresponds to a `Replication Specifications` `zoneId` property. This parameter returns an empty object if no custom zones exist. Example: `{"US-VA": "6716c5a804f4ce77e899bf99", "DE": "6716c5a804f4ce77e899bf9a"}`. |
| `managedNamespaces` | `object[] \| null` | No | List that contains a namespace for a Global Cluster. MongoDB Cloud manages this cluster. |
| `selfManagedSharding` | `boolean \| null` | No | Boolean that controls which management mode the Global Cluster is operating under. If this parameter is true Self-Managed Sharding is enabled and users are in control of the zone sharding within the Global Cluster. If this parameter is false Atlas-Managed Sharding is enabled and Atlas is control of zone sharding within the Global Cluster. |

<Accordion title="managedNamespaces full type">

```ts
{
  collection?: string | null,
  customShardKey?: string | null,
  db?: string | null,
  isCustomShardKeyHashed?: boolean | null,
  isShardKeyUnique?: boolean | null,
  numInitialChunks?: number | null,

}[] | null
```

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.invoices.createCostExplorerProcess({ orgId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', endDate: '2026-04-09', startDate: '2026-04-09' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `orgId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization that contains your projects. Use the [`/orgs`](#tag/Organizations/operation/listOrganizations) endpoint to retrieve all organizations to which the authenticated user has access. |
| `clusters` | `string[]` | No | The list of clusters to be included in the Cost Explorer Query. |
| `endDate` | `string` | Yes | The exclusive ending date for the Cost Explorer query. The date must be the start of a month. |
| `groupBy` | `organizations \| projects \| clusters \| services` | No | The dimension to group the returned usage results by. At least one filter value needs to be provided for a dimension to be used. |
| `includePartialMatches` | `boolean` | No | Flag to control whether usage that matches the filter criteria, but does not have values for all filter criteria is included in response. Default is false, which excludes the partially matching data. |

| `projects` | `string[]` | No | The list of projects to be included in the Cost Explorer Query. |
| `services` | `string[]` | No | The list of SKU services to be included in the Cost Explorer Query. |
| `startDate` | `string` | Yes | The inclusive starting date for the Cost Explorer query. The date must be the start of a month. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `token` | `string \| null` | No | The token used to identify the created Cost Explorer query. |

### getInvoice

`invoices.getInvoice`

Return One Invoice for One Organization: returns one invoice that MongoDB issued to the specified organization

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.invoices.getInvoice({ orgId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', invoiceId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `invoiceId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the invoice submitted to the specified organization. Charges typically post the next day. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `amountPaidCents` | `number \| null` | No | Sum that the specified organization paid toward this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in cents (100ths of one US Dollar). |
| `created` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when MongoDB Cloud created this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `creditsCents` | `number \| null` | No | Sum that MongoDB credited the specified organization toward this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in cents (100ths of one US Dollar). |
| `endDate` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when MongoDB Cloud finished the billing period that this invoice covers. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the invoice submitted to the specified organization. Charges typically post the next day. |
| `lineItems` | `object[] \| null` | No | List that contains individual services included in this invoice. |
| `linkedInvoices` | `object[] \| null` | No | List that contains the invoices for organizations linked to the paying organization. |
| `links` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships. |
| `orgId` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization charged for services consumed from MongoDB Cloud. |
| `payments` | `object[] \| null` | No | List that contains funds transferred to MongoDB to cover the specified service noted in this invoice. |
| `refunds` | `object[] \| null` | No | List that contains payments that MongoDB returned to the organization for this invoice. |
| `salesTaxCents` | `number \| null` | No | Sum of sales tax applied to this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in cents (100ths of one US Dollar). |
| `startDate` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when MongoDB Cloud began the billing period that this invoice covers. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `startingBalanceCents` | `number \| null` | No | Sum that the specified organization owed to MongoDB when MongoDB issued this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in US Dollars. |
| `statusName` | `string \| null` | No | Phase of payment processing in which this invoice exists when you made this request. Accepted phases include: - `CLOSED`: MongoDB finalized all charges in the billing cycle but has yet to charge the customer. - `FAILED`: MongoDB attempted to charge the provided credit card but charge for that amount failed. - `FORGIVEN`: Customer initiated payment which MongoDB later forgave. - `FREE`: All charges totalled zero so the customer won't be charged. - `INVOICED`: MongoDB handled these charges using e |
| `subtotalCents` | `number \| null` | No | Sum of all positive invoice line items contained in this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in cents (100ths of one US Dollar). |
| `updated` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when MongoDB Cloud last updated the value of this payment. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |

### getInvoiceCsv

`invoices.getInvoiceCsv`

Return One Invoice as CSV for One Organization: returns one invoice that MongoDB issued to the specified organization in CSV format (returned as a file)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.invoices.getInvoiceCsv({ orgId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', invoiceId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `orgId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization that contains your projects. Use the [`/orgs`](#tag/Organizations/operation/listOrganizations) endpoint to retrieve all organizations to which the authenticated user has access. |
| `invoiceId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the invoice submitted to the specified organization. Charges typically post the next day. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### listInvoices

`invoices.listInvoices`

Return All Invoices for One Organization: returns all invoices that MongoDB issued to the specified organization (paged with pageNum / itemsPerPage)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.invoices.listInvoices({ orgId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `includeCount` | `boolean` | No | Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Cloud calculates the total number of items for the response. When set to `false`, MongoDB Cloud may skip an additional count operation. The response may still include `totalCount` when the count is available without additional calculation. |
| `itemsPerPage` | `number` | No | Number of items that the response returns per page. |
| `orgId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization that contains your projects. Use the [`/orgs`](#tag/Organizations/operation/listOrganizations) endpoint to retrieve all organizations to which the authenticated user has access. |
| `pageNum` | `number` | No | Number of the page that displays the current set of the total objects that the response returns. |
| `viewLinkedInvoices` | `boolean` | No | Flag that indicates whether to return linked invoices in the `linkedInvoices` field. |
| `statusNames` | `(PENDING \| CLOSED \| FORGIVEN \| FAILED \| PAID \| FREE \| PREPAID \| INVOICED)[]` | No | Statuses of the invoice to be retrieved. Omit to return invoices of all statuses. |
| `fromDate` | `string` | No | Retrieve the invoices the `startDates` of which are greater than or equal to the `fromDate`. If omit, the invoices return will go back to earliest `startDate`. |
| `toDate` | `string` | No | Retrieve the invoices the `endDates` of which are smaller than or equal to the `toDate`. If omit, the invoices return will go further to latest `endDate`. |
| `sortBy` | `START_DATE \| END_DATE` | No | Field used to sort the returned invoices by. Use in combination with `orderBy` parameter to control the order of the result. |
| `orderBy` | `desc \| asc` | No | Field used to order the returned invoices by. Use in combination of `sortBy` parameter to control the order of the result. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `links` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships. |
| `results` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of returned documents that MongoDB Cloud provides when completing this request. |
| `totalCount` | `number \| null` | No | Total number of documents available. When `includeCount` is set to `false`, MongoDB Cloud may omit this value or return it when the count is available without additional calculation. The total number is an estimate and may not be exact. |

| `autoDeferOnceEnabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Cloud should defer all maintenance windows for one week after you enable them. This setting controls the same underlying auto-deferral feature as the `/maintenanceWindow/autoDefer` endpoint. Use either this field (to set a specific value) or that endpoint (to toggle the current value). For most use cases, this field in the PATCH request is preferred because it allows setting an explicit value rather than toggling. |
| `dayOfWeek` | `number \| null` | No | One-based integer that represents the day of the week, in the project's configured time zone (see `timeZoneId`), that the maintenance window starts. - `1`: Sunday. - `2`: Monday. - `3`: Tuesday. - `4`: Wednesday. - `5`: Thursday. - `6`: Friday. - `7`: Saturday. |
| `effectiveWaveAssignment` | `number \| null` | No | Maintenance wave that Atlas uses when scheduling maintenance for this project. This read-only value can differ from `waveAssignment` in two scenarios: (1) when the organization's `effectiveWaveAssignmentMode` is `ENV_TAG_MAPPING`, the effective wave is derived from environment tags regardless of any explicit assignment; (2) when cross-organization maintenance sequencing is active and this project's organization is a linked non-paying organization, the effective wave reflects the paying organizat |
| `hourOfDay` | `number \| null` | No | Zero-based integer that represents the hour of the day, in the project's configured time zone (see `timeZoneId`), that the maintenance window starts according to a 24-hour clock. Use `0` for midnight and `12` for noon. If you haven't changed your project's time zone, this defaults to UTC. |
| `numberOfDeferrals` | `number \| null` | No | Number of times the current maintenance event for this project has been deferred. |
| `protectedHours` | `object \| null` | No | Defines the a window where maintenance will not begin within. |
| `startASAP` | `boolean \| null` | No | Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Cloud starts the maintenance window immediately upon receiving this request. To start the maintenance window immediately for your project, MongoDB Cloud must have maintenance scheduled and you must set a maintenance window. This flag resets to `false` after MongoDB Cloud completes maintenance. |
| `timeZoneId` | `string \| null` | No | Identifier for the current time zone of the maintenance window. This can only be updated via the Project Settings UI. |
| `waveAssignment` | `number \| null \| null` | No | Maintenance wave explicitly assigned to this project. Always returned in GET responses when a value has been set, regardless of the organization's `effectiveWaveAssignmentMode`. When the mode is `ENV_TAG_MAPPING`, this stored assignment is preserved but not used for scheduling — the effective wave is derived from environment tags instead. Not editable when the mode is `ENV_TAG_MAPPING`. Switching back to `MANUAL` restores this value as the effective wave. Must be between 1 and 3, inclusive. Pass |

| `waveAssignment` | `number \| null` | No | Maintenance wave explicitly assigned to this project. Always returned in GET responses when a value has been set, regardless of the organization's `effectiveWaveAssignmentMode`. When the mode is `ENV_TAG_MAPPING`, this stored assignment is preserved but not used for scheduling — the effective wave is derived from environment tags instead. Not editable when the mode is `ENV_TAG_MAPPING`. Switching back to `MANUAL` restores this value as the effective wave. Must be between 1 and 3, inclusive. Pass |

## Metric Integrations

### createGroupMetricIntegration

`metricIntegrations.createGroupMetricIntegration`

Create One Metric Integration: creates a new metric integration configuration identified by a unique ID

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.metricIntegrations.createGroupMetricIntegration({
	groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	aggregationTemporality: 'DELTA',
	authType: 'HEADER',
	endpoint: 'example',
	integrationType: 'OTEL',
	metricSelection: ['ATLAS_STREAM_PROCESSING'],
	providerType: 'CUSTOM',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `aggregationTemporality` | `DELTA \| CUMULATIVE` | Yes | The temporality to send to the metric integration. |
| `authType` | `HEADER \| OAUTH2` | Yes | Authentication method the integration uses when exporting metrics to the endpoint. `HEADER` authenticates with the static HTTP headers provided in the `headers` field, which must be set when this value is used. `OAUTH2` acquires a bearer token from an OAuth 2.0 token endpoint using the `oauth` field. |

| `integrationType` | `OTEL` | Yes | Type of metric integration. Identifies which protocol will be used for the integration. This value cannot be modified after the integration is created. |
| `metricSelection` | `(ATLAS_STREAM_PROCESSING \| MONGODB_METRICS \| HARDWARE_METRICS \| DB_STATS \| QUERY_SHAPE_INSIGHTS \| SEARCH_METRICS \| SHARDING_METRICS)[]` | Yes | Array of metric categories to export. Determines which types of metrics are sent to the integration. |
| `oauth` | `object` | No | OAuth 2.0 client credentials configuration. Required when `authType` is `OAUTH2`. Secrets are never returned. |
| `providerType` | `CUSTOM \| DATADOG \| DYNATRACE \| NEW_RELIC` | Yes | The provider type for the metric integration. Identifies the third-party service provider. |

## Mongo Db Cloud Users

### addGroupUserRole

`mongoDbCloudUsers.addGroupUserRole`

Add One Project Role to One MongoDB Cloud User: adds one project-level role to the MongoDB Cloud user

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.mongoDbCloudUsers.addGroupUserRole({ groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', userId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', groupRole: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `userId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the pending or active user in the project. If you need to lookup a user's `userId` or verify a user's status in the organization, use the Return All MongoDB Cloud Users in One Project resource and filter by `username`. |
| `groupRole` | `string` | Yes | Project-level role to assign to or remove from the MongoDB Cloud user. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the MongoDB Cloud user. |
| `orgMembershipStatus` | `string \| null` | No | String enum that indicates the user's organization membership status: ACTIVE (member), PENDING (invited), `INVITATION_EXPIRED` (invitation expired), or `INVITATION_REJECTED` (invitation declined). |
| `roles` | `string[] \| null` | No | One or more project-level roles assigned to the MongoDB Cloud user. |
| `username` | `string \| null` | No | Email address that represents the username of the MongoDB Cloud user. |

## Monitoring And Logs

### downloadClusterLog

`monitoringAndLogs.downloadClusterLog`

Download Logs for One Cluster Host in One Project: returns a compressed (.gz) log file that contains a range of log messages for the specified host for the specified project (returned as a file)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.monitoringAndLogs.downloadClusterLog({ groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', hostName: 'cluster0-shard-00-00.abcde.mongodb.net', logName: 'mongodb' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `hostName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the host that stores the log files that you want to download. |
| `logName` | `mongodb \| mongos \| mongodb-audit-log \| mongos-audit-log` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the log file that you want to return. To return audit logs, enable *Database Auditing* for the specified project. |
| `endDate` | `number` | No | Specifies the date and time for the ending point of the range of log messages to retrieve, in the number of seconds that have elapsed since the UNIX epoch. This value will default to 24 hours after the start date. If the start date is also unspecified, the value will default to the time of the request. |
| `startDate` | `number` | No | Specifies the date and time for the starting point of the range of log messages to retrieve, in the number of seconds that have elapsed since the UNIX epoch. This value will default to 24 hours prior to the end date. If the end date is also unspecified, the value will default to 24 hours prior to the time of the request. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### getDatabaseMeasurements

`monitoringAndLogs.getDatabaseMeasurements`

Return Measurements for One Database in One MongoDB Process: returns the measurements of one database for the specified host for the specified project

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.monitoringAndLogs.getDatabaseMeasurements({
	groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	databaseName: 'sample_mflix',
	processId: 'cluster0-shard-00-00.abcde.mongodb.net:27017',
	granularity: 'PT1M',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `databaseName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the database that the specified MongoDB process serves. |
| `m` | `(DATABASE_AVERAGE_OBJECT_SIZE \| DATABASE_COLLECTION_COUNT \| DATABASE_DATA_SIZE \| DATABASE_STORAGE_SIZE \| DATABASE_INDEX_SIZE \| DATABASE_INDEX_COUNT \| DATABASE_EXTENT_COUNT \| DATABASE_OBJECT_COUNT \| DATABASE_VIEW_COUNT)[]` | No | One or more types of measurement to request for this MongoDB process. If omitted, the resource returns all measurements. To specify multiple values for `m`, repeat the `m` parameter for each value. Specify measurements that apply to the specified host. MongoDB Cloud returns an error if you specified any invalid measurements. |
| `processId` | `string` | Yes | Combination of hostname and Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) port that serves the MongoDB process. The host must be the hostname, fully qualified domain name (FQDN), or Internet Protocol address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the host that runs the MongoDB process (`mongod` or `mongos`). The port must be the IANA port on which the MongoDB process listens for requests. |
| `granularity` | `string` | Yes | Duration that specifies the interval at which Atlas reports the metrics. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 duration format in UTC. |
| `period` | `string` | No | Duration over which Atlas reports the metrics. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 duration format in UTC. Include this parameter when you do not set **start** and **end**. |

| `groupId` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project. The project contains MongoDB processes that you want to return. The MongoDB process can be either the `mongod` or `mongos`. |
| `hostId` | `string \| null` | No | Combination of hostname and Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) port that serves the MongoDB process. The host must be the hostname, fully qualified domain name (FQDN), or Internet Protocol address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the host that runs the MongoDB process (`mongod` or `mongos`). The port must be the IANA port on which the MongoDB process listens for requests. |
| `links` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships. |

| `partitionName` | `string \| null` | No | Human-readable label of the disk or partition to which the measurements apply. |
| `processId` | `string \| null` | No | Combination of hostname and Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) port that serves the MongoDB process. The host must be the hostname, fully qualified domain name (FQDN), or Internet Protocol address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the host that runs the MongoDB process (`mongod` or `mongos`). The port must be the IANA port on which the MongoDB process listens for requests. |
| `scale` | `object \| null` | No | Information on scaling the cluster to a tier that supports the requested feature. Present only when the feature is unavailable on the cluster's current tier. |
| `start` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time that specifies when to start retrieving measurements. If you set **start**, you must set **end**. You can't set this parameter and **period** in the same request. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |

### listDatabases

`monitoringAndLogs.listDatabases`

Return Available Databases for One MongoDB Process: returns the list of databases running on the specified host for the specified project (paged with pageNum / itemsPerPage)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.monitoringAndLogs.listDatabases({ groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', processId: 'cluster0-shard-00-00.abcde.mongodb.net:27017' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `includeCount` | `boolean` | No | Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Cloud calculates the total number of items for the response. When set to `false`, MongoDB Cloud may skip an additional count operation. The response may still include `totalCount` when the count is available without additional calculation. |
| `itemsPerPage` | `number` | No | Number of items that the response returns per page. |
| `pageNum` | `number` | No | Number of the page that displays the current set of the total objects that the response returns. |
| `processId` | `string` | Yes | Combination of hostname and Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) port that serves the MongoDB process. The host must be the hostname, fully qualified domain name (FQDN), or Internet Protocol address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the host that runs the MongoDB process (`mongod`). The port must be the IANA port on which the MongoDB process listens for requests. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `links` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships. |
| `results` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of returned documents that MongoDB Cloud provides when completing this request. |
| `totalCount` | `number \| null` | No | Total number of documents available. When `includeCount` is set to `false`, MongoDB Cloud may omit this value or return it when the count is available without additional calculation. The total number is an estimate and may not be exact. |

### downloadQueryLogs

`onlineArchive.downloadQueryLogs`

Download Online Archive Query Logs: downloads query logs for the specified online archive (returned as a file)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.onlineArchive.downloadQueryLogs({ groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', clusterName: 'Cluster0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `startDate` | `number` | No | Date and time that specifies the starting point for the range of log messages to return. This resource expresses this value in the number of seconds that have elapsed since the [UNIX epoch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time). |
| `endDate` | `number` | No | Date and time that specifies the end point for the range of log messages to return. This resource expresses this value in the number of seconds that have elapsed since the [UNIX epoch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time). |
| `clusterName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the cluster that contains the collection for which you want to return the query logs from one online archive. |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

## Organizations

### createOrg

`organizations.createOrg`

Create One Organization: creates one organization in MongoDB Cloud and links it to the requesting Service Account's or API Key's organization

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.organizations.createOrg({ name: 'Cluster0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `apiKey` | `object` | No | Organization Service Account that Atlas creates for this organization. If omitted, Atlas doesn't create an organization Service Account for this organization. If specified, this object requires all body parameters. Note that API Keys cannot be specified in the same request. |
| `federationSettingsId` | `string` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the federation to link the newly created organization to. If specified, the proposed Organization Owner of the new organization must have the Organization Owner role in an organization associated with the federation. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the organization. |
| `orgOwnerId` | `string` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the MongoDB Cloud user that you want to assign the Organization Owner role. This user must be a member of the same organization as the calling API key. If you provide `federationSettingsId`, this user must instead have the Organization Owner role on an organization in the specified federation. This parameter is required only when you authenticate with Programmatic API Keys. |
| `serviceAccount` | `object` | No | Organization Service Account that Atlas creates for this organization. If omitted, Atlas doesn't create an organization Service Account for this organization. If specified, this object requires all body parameters. Note that API Keys cannot be specified in the same request. |
| `skipDefaultAlertsSettings` | `boolean` | No | Disables automatic alert creation. When set to true, no organization level alerts will be created automatically. |

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts

```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `clusterName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the cluster on which to start the overload protection simulation. |
| `durationSeconds` | `number` | Yes | Duration of the overload protection simulation in seconds. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `cancelRequestedAt` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when cancellation of the overload protection simulation was requested. This parameter is only present when a cancellation has been requested and expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `clusterName` | `string \| null` | No | Human-readable label that identifies the cluster on which the simulation is running. |
| `durationSeconds` | `number \| null` | No | Duration of the overload protection simulation in seconds. |
| `expiresAt` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when the overload protection simulation expires. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `groupId` | `string \| null` | No | Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies the project that contains the cluster. |
| `requestDate` | `string \| null` | No | Date and time when the overload protection simulation was requested. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |
| `simulationId` | `string \| null` | No | Unique identifier of the overload protection simulation. |
| `state` | `string \| null` | No | Current state of the overload protection simulation. |

### listClusterSuggestedIndexes

`performanceAdvisor.listClusterSuggestedIndexes`

Return All Suggested Indexes: returns the indexes that the Performance Advisor suggests

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.performanceAdvisor.listClusterSuggestedIndexes({ groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', clusterName: 'Cluster0' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `clusterName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the cluster. |
| `processIds` | `string[]` | No | Process IDs from which to retrieve suggested indexes. A `processId` is a combination of host and port that serves the MongoDB process. The host must be the hostname, FQDN, IPv4 address, or IPv6 address of the host that runs the MongoDB process (`mongod` or `mongos`). The port must be the IANA port on which the MongoDB process listens for requests. To include multiple `processIds`, pass the parameter multiple times delimited with an ampersand (`&`) between each `processId`. |
| `namespaces` | `string[]` | No | Namespaces from which to retrieve suggested indexes. A namespace consists of one database and one collection resource written as `.`: `<database>.<collection>`. To include multiple namespaces, pass the parameter multiple times delimited with an ampersand (`&`) between each namespace. Omit this parameter to return results for all namespaces. |
| `since` | `number` | No | Date and time from which the query retrieves the suggested indexes. This parameter expresses its value in the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the [UNIX epoch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time). - If you don't specify the **until** parameter, the endpoint returns data covering from the **since** value and the current time. - If you specify neither the **since** nor the **until** parameters, the endpoint returns data from the previous 24 hours. |
| `until` | `number` | No | Date and time up until which the query retrieves the suggested indexes. This parameter expresses its value in the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the [UNIX epoch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time). - If you specify the **until** parameter, you must specify the **since** parameter. - If you specify neither the **since** nor the **until** parameters, the endpoint returns data from the previous 24 hours. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `content` | `object \| null` | No | Response that contains Performance Advisor suggested indexes and query shapes. |
| `links` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships. |
| `locations` | `string[] \| null` | No | URLs of resources created by this request. |
| `status` | `number \| null` | No | HTTP status code returned with this response. |

### listSlowQueryLogs

`performanceAdvisor.listSlowQueryLogs`

Return Slow Queries: returns log lines for slow queries that the Performance Advisor and Query Profiler identified

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.performanceAdvisor.listSlowQueryLogs({ groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', processId: 'cluster0-shard-00-00.abcde.mongodb.net:27017' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `duration` | `number` | No | Length of time expressed during which the query finds slow queries among the managed namespaces in the cluster. This parameter expresses its value in milliseconds. - If you don't specify the **since** parameter, the endpoint returns data covering the duration before the current time. - If you specify neither the **duration** nor **since** parameters, the endpoint returns data from the previous 24 hours. |
| `namespaces` | `string[]` | No | Namespaces from which to retrieve slow queries. A namespace consists of one database and one collection resource written as `.`: `<database>.<collection>`. To include multiple namespaces, pass the parameter multiple times delimited with an ampersand (`&`) between each namespace. Omit this parameter to return results for all namespaces. |
| `nLogs` | `number` | No | Maximum number of lines from the log to return. |
| `processId` | `string` | Yes | Combination of host and port that serves the MongoDB process. The host must be the hostname, FQDN, IPv4 address, or IPv6 address of the host that runs the MongoDB process (`mongod` or `mongos`). The port must be the IANA port on which the MongoDB process listens for requests. |
| `since` | `number` | No | Date and time from which the query retrieves the slow queries. This parameter expresses its value in the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the [UNIX epoch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time). - If you don't specify the **duration** parameter, the endpoint returns data covering from the **since** value and the current time. - If you specify neither the **duration** nor the **since** parameters, the endpoint returns data from the previous 24 hours. |
| `includeMetrics` | `boolean` | No | Whether or not to include metrics extracted from the slow query log as separate fields. |
| `includeReplicaState` | `boolean` | No | Whether or not to include the replica state of the host when the slow query log was generated as a separate field. |
| `includeOpType` | `boolean` | No | Whether or not to include the operation type (read/write/command) extracted from the slow query log as a separate field. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `slowQueries` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of operations that the Performance Advisor detected that took longer to execute than a specified threshold. |

## Private Endpoint Services

### createPrivateEndpoint

`privateEndpointServices.createPrivateEndpoint`

Create One Private Endpoint for One Provider: creates one private endpoint for the specified cloud service provider

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.privateEndpointServices.createPrivateEndpoint({
	groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	cloudProvider: 'AWS',
	endpointServiceId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	body: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `cloudProvider` | `AWS \| AZURE \| GCP` | Yes | Cloud service provider that manages this private endpoint. |
| `endpointServiceId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the private endpoint service for which you want to create a private endpoint. |
| `body` | `object` | Yes | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="body full type">

```ts
{
  cloudProvider?: AWS | AZURE | GCP
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `cloudProvider` | `string \| null` | No | Cloud service provider that serves the requested endpoint. |
| `deleteRequested` | `boolean \| null` | No | Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Cloud received a request to remove the specified private endpoint from the private endpoint service. |
| `errorMessage` | `string \| null` | No | Error message returned when requesting private connection resource. The resource returns `null` if the request succeeded. |
| `regionName` | `string \| null` | No | Region name of the private endpoint. |

### createPrivateEndpointService


**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |

Regions accepted as values differ for [Amazon Web Services](https://docs.atlas.mongodb.com/reference/amazon-aws/), [Google Cloud Platform](https://docs.atlas.mongodb.com/reference/google-gcp/), and [Microsoft Azure](https://docs.atlas.mongodb.com/reference/microsoft-azure/). |

### deletePrivateEndpoint

`privateEndpointServices.deletePrivateEndpoint`

Remove One Private Endpoint for One Provider: removes one private endpoint from the specified project and private endpoint service, as managed by the specified cloud service provider

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.privateEndpointServices.deletePrivateEndpoint({
	groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
	cloudProvider: 'AWS',
	endpointId: 'vpce-0123456789abcdef0',
	endpointServiceId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `cloudProvider` | `AWS \| AZURE \| GCP` | Yes | Cloud service provider that manages this private endpoint. |
| `endpointId` | `string` | Yes | Unique string that identifies the private endpoint you want to delete. The format of the `endpointId` parameter differs for AWS and Azure. You must URL encode the `endpointId` for Azure private endpoints. |
| `endpointServiceId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the private endpoint service from which you want to delete a private endpoint. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | MongoDBAtlas accepted the call; it answered with no body (or an empty object). |

## Query Sampling

### createClusterQuerySampling

`querySampling.createClusterQuerySampling`

Create Query Sampling for One Namespace: starts query sampling on one namespace of the specified cluster

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.querySampling.createClusterQuerySampling({ groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', clusterName: 'Cluster0', namespace: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `clusterName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the cluster. |
| `namespace` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the namespace (`<database>.<collection>`) on which to sample queries. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `active` | `boolean \| null` | No | Flag that indicates whether query sampling is observably running on the namespace. May still be `false` in the response to a successful create request; it becomes `true` asynchronously once the cluster applies the sampling configuration. |
| `namespace` | `string \| null` | No | Human-readable label that identifies the namespace (`<database>.<collection>`) on which queries are sampled. |
| `sampledReadsBytes` | `number \| null \| null` | No | Total size in bytes of the read operations sampled on the namespace. |
| `sampledReadsCount` | `number \| null \| null` | No | Number of read operations sampled on the namespace. |
| `sampledWritesBytes` | `number \| null \| null` | No | Total size in bytes of the write operations sampled on the namespace. |
| `sampledWritesCount` | `number \| null \| null` | No | Number of write operations sampled on the namespace. |
| `samplesPerSecond` | `number \| null \| null` | No | Maximum number of queries sampled per second on the namespace. MongoDB Cloud sets this rate. |
| `startTime` | `string \| null \| null` | No | Date and time when query sampling started on the namespace. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC. |



---

## Query Shape Insights

### getClusterQueryShape

`queryShapeInsights.getClusterQueryShape`

Return One Query Shape: returns the details for a single query shape

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.queryShapeInsights.getClusterQueryShape({ groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', clusterName: 'Cluster0', queryShapeHash: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f607185f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f607185f43e7f0a1b2c3d4' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `clusterName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the cluster. |
| `queryShapeHash` | `string` | Yes | A SHA256 hash of a query shape, output by MongoDB commands like `$queryStats` and `$explain` or slow query logs. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `command` | `string \| null` | No | The MongoDB command type issued for a query shape. The INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE commands appear only for clusters running MongoDB 9.0 or later. |
| `namespace` | `string \| null` | No | Human-readable label that identifies the namespace on the specified host. The resource expresses this parameter value as `<database>.<collection>`. |
| `queryShape` | `string \| null` | No | A query shape is a set of specifications that group similar queries together. Specifications can include filters, sorts, projections, aggregation pipeline stages, a namespace, and others. Queries that have similar specifications have the same query shape. This field may be null if the user lacks PII view access. |
| `queryShapeHash` | `string \| null` | No | A hexadecimal string that represents the hash of a MongoDB query shape. |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | The rejection status of a query shape. Use REJECTED to prevent the query shape from executing on the cluster, or UNREJECTED to allow it to execute. |



---

### getQueryShapeDetails

`queryShapeInsights.getQueryShapeDetails`

Return Query Shape Details: returns the metadata and statistics summary for a given query shape hash

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.mongodbatlas.api.queryShapeInsights.getQueryShapeDetails({ groupId: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718', clusterName: 'Cluster0', queryShapeHash: '5f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f607185f43e7f0a1b2c3d4e5f607185f43e7f0a1b2c3d4' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | `string` | Yes | Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. **NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups. |
| `clusterName` | `string` | Yes | Human-readable label that identifies the cluster. |
| `since` | `number` | No | Date and time from which to retrieve query shape statistics. This parameter expresses its value in the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the [UNIX epoch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time). - If you don't specify the **until** parameter, the endpoint returns data covering from the **since** value and the current time. - If you specify neither the **since** nor the **until** parameters, the endpoint returns data from the previous 24 hours. |
| `until` | `number` | No | Date and time up until which to retrieve query shape statistics. This parameter expresses its value in the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the [UNIX epoch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time). - If you specify the **until** parameter, you must specify the **since** parameter. - If you specify neither the **since** nor the **until** parameters, the endpoint returns data from the previous 24 hours. |
| `processIds` | `string[]` | No | Process IDs from which to retrieve query shape statistics. A `processId` is a combination of host and port that serves the MongoDB process. The host must be the hostname, FQDN, IPv4 address, or IPv6 address of the host that runs the MongoDB process (`mongod` or `mongos`). The port must be the IANA port on which the MongoDB process listens for requests. To include multiple `processIds`, pass the parameter multiple times delimited with an ampersand (`&`) between each `processId`. |
| `queryShapeHash` | `string` | Yes | A SHA256 hash of a query shape, output by MongoDB commands like `$queryStats` and `$explain` or slow query logs. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `firstSeen` | `object \| null` | No | Metadata about when a query shape was seen. |
| `lastSeen` | `object \| null` | No | Metadata about when a query shape was seen. |
| `queryStats` | `object \| null` | No | A summary of execution statistics for a given query shape. |
| `queryStatsCollection` | `object \| null` | No | How `queryStats` entries were collected on this cluster's processes. Reflects the collection mode of the cluster's processes regardless of any host or process type filters in the request. Omitted when the collection mode cannot be determined. Sample-based collection requires MongoDB 9.0 or later but may not be enabled on every such cluster; this reflects the mode in effect on the cluster. |
